newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuanian shares continue upward march.
newsitem.headline: Lithuanian shares continue upward march.

text.p: Lithuanian shares continued their recent rise on Monday and dealers said that good results and bargain prices were finally bringing foreign investors to the market, which has been lacklustre for much of the summer.
"I think that the market will continue to rise as results for the first nine months of the year are on the way," Tomas Andrejauskas, a broker with Suprema, told Reuters.
The group A index rose by 45.71 points to 1040.36 points while the elite official list index, which tracks the top five stocks, advanced by 20.78 points to 1177.37 points.
The central market turned over 612,000 litas while 6.299 million litas were registered in block trades.
Dealers said they were caught off guard by Rokishkis Cheese, which soared 9.52 percent to 55 litas.
Dealers have been expecting the share gain in the wake of its promising interim results -- but not so high so fast.
Rokishkis rose to 55 litas from 50.22 litas on 144,000 litas turnover on the central market and registered a 208,000 litas deal in block trades at prices ranging from 50 to 52 litas.
Hermis Bank saw 3.77 million litas worth of its shares change hands in block deals at prices ranging from 265 litas to 270 litas.
Vilniaus Bank advanced to 322.50 litas from 315.10 litas in tiny central market turnover of 2,000 litas.
